title: NASA moon program development at Langley

tellings.quote: NASA's development to get up into space and everything pressurization was done at Langley Air Force Base, Virginia.

plain: In the 1960s, the work that got NASA, the US space agency, into space and toward the Moon was done at Langley Air Force Base in Virginia, including the work on pressurization, meaning how to keep air inside a spacecraft or suit. Dylan Borland, a guest who served in the Air Force, says this in passing and names no source. He brings it up to show how much of the space effort was centred at that one base.
